fixed.delivery: one ZIP with complete code and numbered Google Cloud Shell runbook
fixed.approval: explicit human approval, immutable versions, CAS

current_execution.preparation: Gemini proposes material reviews, questions, workflows and guidance; people review and approve the conditions.
current_execution.execution: The shared three-valued rule engine applies approved declarative conditions to confirmed facts and a frozen starting state.
current_execution.commit: Approval, source versions and case-state freshness are checked; case state and execution receipt are committed atomically.
current_execution.comparison: Original and revised conditions use the same engine, code, cases, facts and starting states.

implementation_bounds.public_session_minutes_scope: CSRF renewal; preserve the owner in a valid signed browser cookie.

original_evaluation.design: 24 unique holdout cases x 3 arms x 3 repeats = 216 nominal judgments
